clusters.name: Accountability and guardrails for AI agents acting for others
clusters.problem_statement: Merchants, counterparties and owners cannot tell who is legally accountable for an autonomous AI agent, what it may do, or how to stop it exceeding its permissions in real systems.

clusters.name: Merchants and bureaucracies that AI agents cannot reach or navigate
clusters.problem_statement: Local businesses, government portals and vendors were built for humans, so consumers' and firms' AI agents cannot reliably get quotes, book, file or act, and merchants cannot monetize or manage agent traffic.

clusters.name: Payments, escrow, disputes and human fulfilment for agent transactions
clusters.problem_statement: Autonomous agents that buy data, negotiate and hire humans lack trustworthy payment, escrow, dispute, price-discovery and real-world verification layers.

clusters.name: AI builders' dependency risk: model retirement, cost blowouts and platform death
clusters.problem_statement: Companies building on third-party AI models and platforms face silent model changes, deprecations, runaway bills, unverifiable vendor claims and shutdowns with no continuity plan.

clusters.name: Proving AI controls and human review to insurers, auditors and clients
clusters.problem_statement: As insurers exclude AI and auditors and clients ask who checked the output, firms and licensed professionals lack credible third-party evidence that their AI use is controlled and reviewed by a responsible human.

clusters.name: Defensible authenticity evidence for disputed digital media
clusters.problem_statement: Lawyers, insurers and courts face forgeable photos, video, audio, screenshots and satellite images and lack affordable, court-defensible authentication and chain of custody.

clusters.name: Small litigation practices lacking evidence, records and benchmark tools
clusters.problem_statement: Small plaintiff, defense and family-law firms lack affordable forensic, transcript, discovery and case-value benchmark capabilities (including for AI chat logs and agent traces) that big firms and insurers take for granted.

clusters.name: Creators proving authorship and stopping unauthorized AI use of their work
clusters.problem_statement: Artists, musicians, voice actors and writers cannot prove they made their work, get wrongly flagged as AI, and cannot detect or stop AI re-posts, clones and impersonation of their work and likeness.

clusters.name: Rights-cleared human data and vetted expert workers for AI labs
clusters.problem_statement: AI labs need licensed, provably human, low-contamination data and compliant expert contractors, while data owners and expert workers lack clean licensing, employment and IP rails.

clusters.name: Real-world skill and object data for robot and industrial-AI builders
clusters.problem_statement: Robot and industrial-AI developers lack standardized real-world manipulation and skill data, while retiring master tradespeople and experts hold unrecorded know-how they could be paid to share.

clusters.name: Buyers unable to verify vendor, algorithm or AI-safety claims
clusters.problem_statement: Buyers of AI detectors, AI toys, robots, wearables, security attestations and pricing algorithms cannot independently verify performance or lawfulness, so they need neutral testing and ratings.

clusters.name: Gatekeepers drowning in AI-generated submissions and bot responses
clusters.problem_statement: Grant funders, contest organizers, procurement offices, open-source maintainers, journals, courts and survey buyers are flooded with polished AI or bot submissions they cannot cheaply screen.

clusters.name: Trusted online signals from verified real people
clusters.problem_statement: Online comments, reviews, testimonials and reports are swamped by bots and fakes, and there is no way to prove 'one real person, from here, who really bought' without exposing identity.

clusters.name: Verifying real human skill, identity and authorship in hiring and education
clusters.problem_statement: Employers and educators can no longer trust remote candidates, take-home work or submitted essays as proof of a real person's skill and need in-person or verified human evidence.

clusters.name: Youth online safety and age-assurance compliance for small platforms
clusters.problem_statement: Small platforms, game studios and app developers must implement age assurance, minor-specific rules, AI disclosure and rapid takedown duties without big-platform resources.

clusters.name: Parents and adults managing phones, screens and AI toys
clusters.problem_statement: Parents and phone-weary adults want practical structures, controls and services to limit screens and unsafe AI toys without isolating themselves or their kids.

clusters.name: Emotional-AI companions: dependence, harm and continuity
clusters.problem_statement: Users of AI companions and wellness chatbots can become dependent or lose the relationship when models change, and vendors face patchwork state rules and litigation.

clusters.name: Recorded and AI-created data exposure for small firms
clusters.problem_statement: Meeting transcripts, chatbot histories, camera glasses and AI-built apps create privacy, privilege and security exposures that small firms cannot manage or audit.

clusters.name: Seniors targeted by impersonation scams and the institutions that bear the losses
clusters.problem_statement: Older adults are hit by voice-clone, government-impersonation and romance scams, and their credit unions, banks and utilities lack human, member-level protection and verification tools.

clusters.name: Banks and platforms disrupting scam networks and recovering victims' funds
clusters.problem_statement: Once scam payments leave a victim's account, small banks, police and brands have little ability to trace, freeze, litigate or make receiving institutions and platforms pay.

clusters.name: Small firms and property managers defending against fraud and impersonation
clusters.problem_statement: Small businesses, finance teams, hotels and property managers are exposed to bank-detail swaps, help-desk resets, leaked IDs, fake support, fake tenants and scam listings.

clusters.name: Independent funeral homes facing key-person, overnight and consolidation pressure
clusters.problem_statement: Owner-operated funeral homes face key-person risk, unstaffed nights, aging owners and roll-up pressure, and need shared operations, continuity and succession help.

clusters.name: Families choosing direct cremation with no ritual
clusters.problem_statement: The growing majority who choose bare-bones cremation later find they need a memorial or ceremony that cremation providers cannot deliver.

clusters.name: Hospice, dying and the first weeks of bereavement
clusters.problem_statement: Hospices, funeral homes and newly widowed spouses handle death certification, aid-in-dying logistics, home resets and aftercare with little support around a death.

clusters.name: Executors and small probate firms drowning in estate paperwork
clusters.problem_statement: Family executors and small probate firms spend disproportionate time on accountings, valuations, notifications and inventories for modest estates and get little affordable help.

clusters.name: Making family estate plans fair and contest-proof
clusters.problem_statement: Families fear that wills and informal parent-to-child money flows will trigger sibling disputes or contests and want evidence of intent, capacity and fair division.

clusters.name: Houses caught in death, divorce or care transitions
clusters.problem_statement: When a homeowner dies, divorces or moves into care, the house sits empty, uninsurable or unaffordable to keep, and family members need to hold, insure, buy out or finance it.

clusters.name: Solo agers without family to act as proxy, executor or guardian
clusters.problem_statement: Childless or estranged older adults and disabled adults have no trusted person to act as health-care proxy, executor, guardian or next of kin when a crisis or death occurs.

clusters.name: Adult children managing aging parents from afar
clusters.problem_statement: Adult children worry about a parent living alone and struggle with the parent's mail, scams, driving and care decisions from a distance.

clusters.name: Dementia and Alzheimer's care at home and in memory care
clusters.problem_statement: Families and aides caring for people with dementia lack tools to calm sundowning, communicate across languages, engage residents and monitor new Alzheimer's drug side effects.

clusters.name: Home and residential care: labor supply, family caregivers and small-scale models
clusters.problem_statement: Care agencies and families cannot recruit, retain or pay caregivers affordably, and small-scale care models are hard to license and staff.

clusters.name: Loneliness and purpose: belonging programs for isolated adults and elders
clusters.problem_statement: Adults and older people are isolated and lack recurring, structured, low-friction ways to belong, and organizations that could fund or host them (payers, venues, senior communities) lack turnkey offerings.

clusters.name: Rural and underserved patients who cannot reach care
clusters.problem_statement: Rural and low-income patients miss care because rides, night staff, specialist capacity, maternity units and transfer beds are unavailable when needed.

clusters.name: Independent pharmacies squeezed by PBMs, refund floats and deserts
clusters.problem_statement: Independent pharmacies lose margin to PBMs, carry cash gaps on negotiated-price refunds and struggle to serve abandoned rural and underinsured customers.

clusters.name: Benefit-rule changes: Medicaid work rules, SNAP and ACA cliffs
clusters.problem_statement: New Medicaid work requirements, SNAP rules and subsidy cliffs make eligible people lose benefits through paperwork failure, and plans, clinics, agencies and retailers lose revenue or face penalties.

clusters.name: Provider revenue leaks and payer denials
clusters.problem_statement: Hospitals, ambulance agencies, surgery centers and clinics lose money to unbilled carve-outs, silent payer clawbacks, Medicare Advantage denials and patient benefit confusion.

clusters.name: Follow-up gaps and anxiety after consumer scans and mega-panels
clusters.problem_statement: People buying whole-body scans, cancer blood tests and mega-panels get incidental findings and anxiety without anyone owning interpretation and follow-up.

clusters.name: Preventive and longevity care outside conventional insurance
clusters.problem_statement: Health-conscious consumers, employers and advisors want evidence-based longevity and preventive care delivered affordably through primary care, HSAs and member groups.

clusters.name: Behavioral health and addiction care capacity
clusters.problem_statement: Clinics, sober-living operators and counties lack trained supervisors, standards and infrastructure to deliver behavioral-health, addiction and crisis follow-up care.

clusters.name: Health-tech and device makers needing regulatory-grade validation evidence
clusters.problem_statement: Device, clinical-AI and health-IT vendors need affordable, credible validation data and conformance testing to satisfy regulators and buyers.

clusters.name: Businesses adapting to GLP-1 users' changed consumption
clusters.problem_statement: Restaurants, food makers, apparel brands and planners see GLP-1 users eat and buy differently and lack data, formats and products for them.

clusters.name: GLP-1 patients' transitions: procedures, medication changes, quitting and aftercare
clusters.problem_statement: People starting or stopping GLP-1 drugs face avoidable harms and relapse (aspiration at surgery, unadjusted meds, eating-disorder risk, regain, muscle loss) and no one is paid to manage the transitions.

clusters.name: Access, affordability and supply integrity for GLP-1 and compounded drugs
clusters.problem_statement: Patients and employers struggle to afford, obtain and trust GLP-1 and look-alike drugs as prices, compounding rules and gray markets shift.

clusters.name: Recovery-studio and peptide businesses needing safety evidence and insurability
clusters.problem_statement: Recovery studios, peptide clinics and sauna operators face insurers and payment processors demanding testing, logs and evidence they do not yet have.

clusters.name: Protein and fermentation capacity squeeze
clusters.problem_statement: Whey shortages and price spikes hit food and feed makers, while brewery, distillery and alt-protein fermentation capacity sits idle.

clusters.name: Restaurants' idle hours, used oil and credit risk
clusters.problem_statement: Independent restaurants and their suppliers face thin margins, idle dead hours, underused kitchens, used-oil contracts and failing accounts.

clusters.name: Food and beverage producers facing new rules and safety risks
clusters.problem_statement: Small food, beverage and pet-food makers must reformulate, test and document to meet dye bans, THC rules, recalls and allergen changes without QA departments.

clusters.name: Farm and ranch risks: disease, cash, storage and machinery
clusters.problem_statement: Farmers and ranchers face livestock disease, counterparty and deferred-payment risk, idle storage and machinery breakdowns with little early warning.

clusters.name: Water scarcity: irrigation allocation and new supply
clusters.problem_statement: Growers, districts, industry and developers face allocation caps, unmetered pumping and drought and need ways to conserve, trade, meter or find new water.

clusters.name: Smallholders and rural households in emerging markets
clusters.problem_statement: Smallholder farmers and rural households in Africa and other emerging markets lack reliable inputs, insurance, energy, devices, school resources and market links.

clusters.name: PFAS exposure, testing and disposal
clusters.problem_statement: Brands, farm lenders, schools and utilities face PFAS liability but lack affordable shared testing, source tracing and disposal chain of custody.

clusters.name: Small water utilities: staffing, revenue leakage, lead lines and nitrate
clusters.problem_statement: Small water systems lack certified operators, meter-revenue recovery, lead-line inventories and treatment capacity to meet regulations and growth.

clusters.name: Localities, utilities and landowners facing speculative data-center demand
clusters.problem_statement: Counties, co-ops and landowners face data-center proposals with little independent evidence, negotiating leverage or way to tell real projects from paper ones.

clusters.name: Getting power for large loads and storage
clusters.problem_statement: Data centers, batteries and factories are blocked by interconnection queues, equipment shortages and grid-code testing requirements.

clusters.name: Data center build quality, commissioning and waste-heat reuse
clusters.problem_statement: AI data-center builders and neoclouds need specialized testing, documentation and heat and hardware reuse to finish projects and cut costs.

clusters.name: Lenders and investors unable to verify collateral exists
clusters.problem_statement: Asset-based lenders and investors lack independent verification that pledged assets (GPUs, inventory, receivables, livestock, whisky) exist, are unique to one lender and are in the condition claimed.

clusters.name: Households upgrading homes: electrification, roofs and solar loans
clusters.problem_statement: Homeowners and landlords face high cost, contractor friction and hidden financing fees when adding heat pumps, batteries, roofs and solar to aging homes.

clusters.name: Utilities avoiding costly network upgrades with distributed flexibility
clusters.problem_statement: Utilities and grid buyers need bankable, verifiable flexible capacity from batteries, water systems and other loads to avoid expensive upgrades.

clusters.name: Residential solar leftovers: orphaned systems, leases and liens
clusters.problem_statement: Homeowners, lenders and installers are stuck with systems, leases and liens left behind by bankrupt or exited solar installers.

clusters.name: Critical minerals and rare-earth supply chain recovery and provenance
clusters.problem_statement: US magnet, battery and metals supply chains lack economic ways to recover, assay, separate and prove provenance of critical materials from scrap and by-products.

clusters.name: Recycling quality, distressed capacity and battery/EPR compliance
clusters.problem_statement: Recyclers, brands and municipalities struggle with unpriced material quality, stranded plants and stacked producer-responsibility and battery-passport obligations.

clusters.name: Brands substantiating origin, recycled-content and green claims
clusters.problem_statement: Brands making Made-in-USA, recycled, green or factory-origin claims face regulators and litigators demanding substantiation they cannot produce.

clusters.name: Recovering IEEPA tariff refunds and surcharges
clusters.problem_statement: Small importers, dormant importers and the buyers who paid tariff surcharges are owed refunds but lack the paperwork capacity or leverage to claim them.

clusters.name: Tariff cost, classification and customs for small importers
clusters.problem_statement: Small importers and brands cannot model tariff exposure, re-engineer products across tariff lines or handle customs and landed-cost complexity.

clusters.name: EU digital product laws for small connected-device makers
clusters.problem_statement: Small hardware and software makers must meet EU Cyber Resilience Act, Data Act and repair-rights duties with no security or compliance team.

clusters.name: Exporters meeting foreign sustainability and representation rules
clusters.problem_statement: Non-EU and mid-size exporters must meet EU sustainability, traceability and local-representation rules and mandatory regimes such as halal certification.

clusters.name: US machine shops and reshoring manufacturers
clusters.problem_statement: Small US shops and reshoring manufacturers are constrained by finishing capacity, material substitution, tooling held abroad and site power.

clusters.name: New defense and drone suppliers: compliance and financing hurdles
clusters.problem_statement: First-time defense and drone manufacturers must clear clearance, property-control, cybersecurity, origin and financing hurdles to win and fulfil contracts.

clusters.name: Aircraft and drone operators: maintenance, parts, permits and navigation
clusters.problem_statement: Commercial aviation and drone operators need dependable maintenance, parts, permitting and navigation support as fleets scale and GPS is degraded.

clusters.name: Skilled-trades labor gap
clusters.problem_statement: Trade shops and factories cannot find enough journeymen or supervisors and lose experienced workers to retirement.

clusters.name: Condition monitoring for asset owners and their service contractors
clusters.problem_statement: Owners of trees, refrigeration, ducts, lake ice, toilets and buildings rely on periodic inspections and emergency calls instead of condition data.

clusters.name: Small builders' crew coordination, permits and speed
clusters.problem_statement: Small homebuilders and developers lose time and money to subcontractor scheduling, permitting and slow foundations, wiring and plan sets.

clusters.name: Repricing softening property markets
clusters.problem_statement: Lenders, buyers and appraisers cannot underwrite offices, multifamily and new builds accurately as concessions, vacancy and rates shift.

clusters.name: Home closings, condo boards and HOAs tangled in title and records rules
clusters.problem_statement: Title agents, condo boards and HOAs face lien, records, investor-cap and insurance requirements that stall closings and governance.

clusters.name: Landlords in soft markets: vouchers, evictions, vacancies and retention
clusters.problem_statement: Landlords and property managers in soft markets must fill units, comply with voucher and eviction rules and audit their managers.

clusters.name: Small commercial tenants and renters facing landlord leverage
clusters.problem_statement: Small businesses and renters lack data and bargaining power on lease renewals, pass-throughs and lease succession.

clusters.name: Housing for workers priced out of tight markets
clusters.problem_statement: Employers and workers in tight housing markets need employer-backed leases, seasonal beds and modular housing.

clusters.name: Homeowners and communities losing property insurance in high-risk areas
clusters.problem_statement: Homeowners, agents and communities hit by nonrenewals cannot prove mitigation or insurability or access capital that would price them fairly.

clusters.name: Flood and fire survivors: mapping, buyouts, claims and rebuilding
clusters.problem_statement: Flood- and fire-hit households cannot easily win fair claims, unlock trapped loss-draft money, or exit repeatedly flooded homes.

clusters.name: Cover and data for emerging or neglected risks
clusters.problem_statement: Reinsurers and corporates lack data and products for small cat bonds, energization delays, robot accidents, battery fires and career-collapse risk.

clusters.name: Fast parametric cash for weather and disaster shocks
clusters.problem_statement: Vendors, restaurants and households lose income and cash within hours or days of weather, evacuation or outage events but get no fast payout.

clusters.name: Heat, fire and evacuation protection for vulnerable people
clusters.problem_statement: Older residents, campers, workers and pets in fire, flood and heat events lack pre-contracted transport, shelter and cooling.

clusters.name: Informal finance and payment frictions in emerging markets
clusters.problem_statement: Savings groups, mobile-money merchants and informal traders lack credit records, reliable rails, tax-filing help and dispute recourse.

clusters.name: Cross-border money movement and stablecoin rails
clusters.problem_statement: Businesses and small players lack controls, cash-out points and low-cost payout and settlement rails for stablecoin and open-banking flows.

clusters.name: Households in debt distress
clusters.problem_statement: Financially stressed consumers borrow at high cost or gamble impulsively and lack tools to consolidate, negotiate or guard their spending.

clusters.name: Consumer lenders' compliance and loss pressures
clusters.problem_statement: Small auto lenders and fintechs must handle new reporting, add-on and earned-wage rules and repossession losses.

clusters.name: Gig, tipped and cash workers unable to prove income
clusters.problem_statement: Gig, tipped, household and freelance workers cannot document income or work history to lenders or landlords and lack benefits or income-shock cover.

clusters.name: Small firms facing serial-plaintiff, troll and patent exposure
clusters.problem_statement: Small businesses receive demand letters from serial plaintiffs and patent trolls and face royalty exposure without affordable counsel.

clusters.name: Unclaimed money: settlements, refunds, penalties and unpaid invoices
clusters.problem_statement: Individuals and small firms leave money on the table because settlement, refund, royalty and small-claim processes cost more effort than they pay.

clusters.name: Warranty claims left unfiled
clusters.problem_statement: Equipment and lab owners let valuable warranty and guarantee claims lapse because tracking and filing them is tedious.

clusters.name: Immigrant households and workers: status deadlines and paperwork
clusters.problem_statement: Immigrant families and their employers risk losing status or safety through missed deadlines, documentation gaps and sudden detention.

clusters.name: Diaspora families managing death, care and property across borders
clusters.problem_statement: Immigrant and diaspora families must handle distant deaths, remains, land succession, elder care and postpartum traditions across borders.

clusters.name: Microschools, homeschoolers and shrinking districts
clusters.problem_statement: Microschool founders and shrinking districts need compliant space, curricula, funding and insurance to serve homeschoolers.

clusters.name: Childcare shortage: providers, buildings and employer funding
clusters.problem_statement: Families and employers cannot find affordable childcare and providers lack space, coverage and quality support.

clusters.name: Out-of-school time, phone-free play and youth sports safety
clusters.problem_statement: Parents need supervised, screen-free after-school and Friday programs and safer youth sports.

clusters.name: K-12 districts' legal service duties: IEPs, attendance, nutrition and Title I
clusters.problem_statement: Districts, special-education families and teachers must meet legal duties without sufficient tools, evidence or staffing.

clusters.name: Colleges and training programs under new federal loan caps and earnings tests
clusters.problem_statement: Colleges, professional programs, students and short-term training providers face loan caps, closures and earnings tests.

clusters.name: Entry-level pipeline broken by AI
clusters.problem_statement: New graduates and displaced workers lack junior roles where they build judgment and credentials as AI absorbs entry-level tasks.

clusters.name: Employers restructuring for AI: layoffs, severance and displaced workers
clusters.problem_statement: Employers cutting staff for AI and the workers and lenders affected need compliant, humane and transition-friendly processes.

clusters.name: Workforce compliance for remote, tipped and platform workers
clusters.problem_statement: Employers face complex tax, wage, safety and platform-labour compliance for remote, tipped, farm and gig workers.

clusters.name: Trade-shop succession and buyouts
clusters.problem_statement: Retiring owners of trade shops and service firms and their would-be buyers lack structures to hand over ownership and licenses.

clusters.name: Owner wind-down, sudden death and tacit-knowledge handoff
clusters.problem_statement: Small-business owners who close, retire or die leave customers, assets and tacit know-how without a plan or interim operator.

clusters.name: Private-equity roll-up aftermath
clusters.problem_statement: Roll-ups leave dropped clients, orphaned jobs, stuck executives and integration problems that others can serve.

clusters.name: Small trade and service firms underpricing and leaking margin
clusters.problem_statement: Small service firms lose money from stale pricing, unbilled parts, junk leads, bad vendor contracts and poor back-office tools.

clusters.name: Cash-flow gaps from slow-paying institutions
clusters.problem_statement: Small vendors and providers wait weeks or months for payment from schools, agencies, platforms or programs and need fast-pay advances.

clusters.name: Teleoperated labor and remote pilot workforces
clusters.problem_statement: Robot, vehicle and machine makers need trusted remote operators to bridge autonomy gaps, and workers gain access to distant jobs.

clusters.name: Deploying robots in the real world
clusters.problem_statement: Buildings, cities and operators need access rules, safety testing, insurance and viable demand for robots and second-hand robot fleets.

clusters.name: Autonomous-vehicle fleets' ground infrastructure and stakeholders
clusters.problem_statement: Robotaxi and driverless-truck fleets need depots, charging, night receiving, first-responder interfaces and human help, and cities lose revenue.

clusters.name: Customers stranded when a product's maker disappears
clusters.problem_statement: Owners of hardware, cameras, buses, robots, drones and games lose support, parts, cloud or servers when a maker fails or exits.

clusters.name: Trading cards and collectibles market infrastructure
clusters.problem_statement: Collectors, shops and promoters lack trustworthy scarcity data, theft registries, lawful formats and tournament infrastructure.

clusters.name: Resellers and liquidators of surplus and fandom goods
clusters.problem_statement: Resellers and fans need trusted access to surplus, drops and overseas fandom goods and ways to escrow, value and ship them.

clusters.name: Crowdfunded hardware makers and indie product brands
clusters.problem_statement: Small hardware makers and indie brands lack demand proof, landed-cost planning, IP protection and buyer support.

clusters.name: Independent game studios and creator businesses
clusters.problem_statement: Game studios and online creators face platform-policy cliffs, launch collisions, royalty reporting and device constraints.

clusters.name: Small venues, performers and event vendors
clusters.problem_statement: Small venues, performers, photographers and event vendors need new revenue and access services.

clusters.name: Independent gyms, studios and racquet venues
clusters.problem_statement: Independent gyms, studios and racquet venues face churn, compliance, insurance and noise pushback.

clusters.name: Shrinking institutions with idle buildings
clusters.problem_statement: Closing congregations, banks and hospitals hold empty buildings and contents and need graceful closure or reuse.

clusters.name: Pet owners and insurers squeezed by rising vet bills
clusters.problem_statement: Pet owners cannot afford veterinary care and insurers face claim-cost inflation and denials.

clusters.name: Veterinary practices: capacity, workforce, diagnostics and drugs
clusters.problem_statement: Vet practices are short of technicians and time and lack tools for at-home diagnostics, monitoring and new drugs.

clusters.name: Pets at risk: owner crises, shelters and transport paperwork
clusters.problem_statement: Pets and shelters face crisis when owners die or are hospitalized and when animals travel.

clusters.name: New-space economy: operator gaps and LEO service users' risks
clusters.problem_statement: Small satellite operators and users of LEO services face gaps in sites, licensing, testing, data and coverage risk.

clusters.name: Novel environmental and infrastructure data from satellites and crowd-sensing
clusters.problem_statement: Open satellite, radar and crowd-sensed data can be turned into products for explorers, asset owners, insurers and cities.

clusters.name: Investors, lenders and venues wanting real-economy ground truth
clusters.problem_statement: Funds, lenders and new trading venues lack timely ground-truth data, verified data histories or integrity monitoring.

clusters.name: Autonomous and AI-directed labs: infrastructure, safety and access
clusters.problem_statement: AI-directed and automated labs need physical execution networks, calibration, biosafety and access controls.

clusters.name: Wet-lab reagents and screens for AI-designed therapeutics
clusters.problem_statement: Researchers and biotech builders need trustworthy reagents, reference materials and specialized assays for AI-designed molecules.

clusters.name: Biotech capital: diligence and salvage
clusters.problem_statement: Biotech investors and buyers cannot verify scientific claims, and shuttered labs strand data, equipment and projects.

clusters.name: Rural sheriffs, jails and small police agencies
clusters.problem_statement: Small law-enforcement agencies and jails lack night medical screening, cyber compliance, drone detection and staff protection.

clusters.name: City and county governments: thin staff, grants and vendor oversight
clusters.problem_statement: Small governments lack staff to pursue grants, price-check vendors and audit surveillance systems.

clusters.name: Overtouristed destinations, tour operators and independent hotels
clusters.problem_statement: Overtouristed places, tour operators and independent hotels need tools to steer visitors, comply with rules and protect margin.

clusters.name: Freight brokers, carriers and shippers: fraud, liability and disputes
clusters.problem_statement: Freight brokers, small carriers and shippers face fictitious pickups, liability, opaque margins and reclass disputes.

clusters.name: Fisheries and ecosystem-service operators
clusters.problem_statement: Small fishing fleets and ecological service providers face volatile catches and unreliable markets.

clusters.name: Language, hearing and communication barriers in services and workplaces
clusters.problem_statement: People with language, hearing or communication barriers struggle to access public services and workplaces.

clusters.name: Land and property facts trapped in county records
clusters.problem_statement: Buyers, developers and heirs cannot see who owns, controls or is assembling land because records are unstructured.

clusters.name: Singular / uncategorized
clusters.problem_statement: One-off ideas that do not share an underlying problem with any other cluster.
